parts.name: monkey
sources: tomk, monkey 3d model rigged fbx (2016): monkey.FBX and its textures. https://opengameart.org/content/monkey-3d-model-rigged-fbx CC0 1.0 (public domain): https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
A monkey of a cartoon (khỉ): about 60 cm high when it stands, a brown coat, a light face, belly, hands and feet, a long tail.
The model is a monkey of a game, not of one real species. The height is a guess: a macaque is about 50 to 60 cm high when it stands.
